    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "import seaborn as sns\n",
        "import warnings\n",
        "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Set style for beautiful charts\n",
        "plt.style.use('seaborn-v0_8')\n",
        "sns.set_palette(\"husl\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Ready for visualization!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "eyasyhPOQdpF",
        "outputId": "0ba09955-a3c8-48b5-d07a-d065668590b6"
      },
      "execution_count": 1,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Ready for visualization!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import requests\n",
        "from bs4 import BeautifulSoup\n",
        "\n",
        "# Scrape fresh data\n",
        "all_books = []\n",
        "for page in range(1, 6):\n",
        "    url = f\"http://books.toscrape.com/catalogue/page-{page}.html\"\n",
        "    response = requests.get(url)\n",
        "    soup = BeautifulSoup(response.text, \"html.parser\")\n",
        "    for book in soup.find_all(\"article\", class_=\"product_pod\"):\n",
        "        title = book.h3.a[\"title\"]\n",
        "        price = book.find(\"p\", class_=\"price_color\").text\n",
        "        rating = book.p[\"class\"][1]\n",
        "        all_books.append({\n",
        "            \"Title\": title,\n",
        "            \"Price\": price,\n",
        "            \"Rating\": rating\n",
        "        })\n",
        "\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame(all_books)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Clean data\n",
        "df['Price'] = df['Price'].str.replace('Â£','').str.replace('£','')\n",
        "df['Price'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Price'])\n",
        "rating_map = {'One':1,'Two':2,'Three':3,'Four':4,'Five':5}\n",
        "df['Rating_Num'] = df['Rating'].map(rating_map)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Data ready! Total books:\", len(df))\n",
        "print(df.head())"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "ILSbsjYY0jdS",
        "outputId": "1990c077-69f5-4bde-a3fb-c53fc088fbee"
      },
      "execution_count": 2,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Data ready! Total books: 100\n",
            "                                   Title  Price Rating  Rating_Num\n",
            "0                   A Light in the Attic  51.77  Three           3\n",
            "1                     Tipping the Velvet  53.74    One           1\n",
            "2                             Soumission  50.10    One           1\n",
            "3                          Sharp Objects  47.82   Four           4\n",
            "4  Sapiens: A Brief History of Humankind  54.23   Five           5\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))\n",
        "fig.suptitle('Books Rating Analysis',\n",
        "             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')\n",
        "\n",
        "  # Bar Chart\n",
        "rating_counts = df['Rating'].value_counts()\n",
        "axes[0].bar(rating_counts.index,\n",
        "                         rating_counts.values,\n",
        "                                     color=['#FF6B6B','#4ECDC4','#45B7D1',\n",
        "                                                        '#96CEB4','#FFEAA7'])\n",
        "axes[0].set_title('Number of Books per Rating')\n",
        "axes[0].set_xlabel('Rating')\n",
        "axes[0].set_ylabel('Number of Books')\n",
        "for i, v in enumerate(rating_counts.values):\n",
        "    axes[0].text(i, v+0.2, str(v), ha='center')\n",
        "\n",
        "#piechart\n",
        "axes[1].pie(rating_counts.values,\n",
        "                                                                        labels=rating_counts.index,\n",
        "                                                                                    autopct='%1.1f%%',\n",
        "                                                                                                colors=['#FF6B6B','#4ECDC4','#45B7D1',\n",
        "                                                                                                                    '#96CEB4','#FFEAA7'])\n",
        "axes[1].set_title('Rating Distribution %')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig('chart1_rating.png', dpi=150)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "print(\"Chart 1 & 2 saved!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "0rREhibk4-p8",
        "colab": {

      "execution_count": 3,

            ],

          },

        {

            "Chart 1 & 2 saved!\n"
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))\n",
        "fig.suptitle('Books Price Analysis',\n",
        "             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Line Chart - Average price by rating\n",
        "avg_price = df.groupby('Rating_Num')['Price'].mean()\n",
        "axes[0].plot(avg_price.index, avg_price.values,\n",
        "             marker='o', linewidth=2,\n",
        "             color='#E74C3C', markersize=8)\n",
        "axes[0].fill_between(avg_price.index,\n",
        "                      avg_price.values, alpha=0.3)\n",
        "axes[0].set_title('Average Price by Rating')\n",
        "axes[0].set_xlabel('Rating (1-5)')\n",
        "axes[0].set_ylabel('Average Price (£)')\n",
        "axes[0].set_xticks([1,2,3,4,5])\n",
        "\n",
        "# Scatter Plot\n",
        "scatter = axes[1].scatter(df['Rating_Num'],\n",
        "                          df['Price'],\n",
        "                          c=df['Rating_Num'],\n",
        "                          cmap='viridis',\n",
        "                          alpha=0.6, s=80)\n",
        "axes[1].set_title('Price vs Rating')\n",
        "axes[1].set_xlabel('Rating (1-5)')\n",
        "axes[1].set_ylabel('Price (£)')\n",
        "plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[1])\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig('chart2_price.png', dpi=150)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "print(\"Chart 3 & 4 saved!\")"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 237

      },
      "execution_count": 4,

              "<Figure size 1400x600 with 3 Axes>"

          },

        {

        }

    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))\n",
        "fig.suptitle('Advanced Analysis',\n",
        "             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Heatmap\n",
        "corr_data = df[['Price','Rating_Num']].corr()\n",
        "sns.heatmap(corr_data, annot=True,\n",
        "            cmap='coolwarm', ax=axes[0],\n",
        "            fmt='.2f', linewidths=0.5)\n",
        "axes[0].set_title('Correlation Heatmap')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Boxplot\n",
        "df.boxplot(column='Price', by='Rating',\n",
        "           ax=axes[1],\n",
        "           patch_artist=True)\n",
        "axes[1].set_title('Price Distribution by Rating')\n",
        "axes[1].set_xlabel('Rating')\n",
        "axes[1].set_ylabel('Price (£)')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig('chart3_advanced.png', dpi=150)\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "print(\"Chart 5 & 6 saved!\")"
      ],

    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))\n",
        "fig.suptitle('📚 Complete Books Data Dashboard',\n",
        "             fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot 1\n",
        "ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 1)\n",
        "rating_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1,\n",
        "                   color='skyblue')\n",
        "ax1.set_title('Books per Rating')\n",
        "ax1.set_xlabel('Rating')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot 2\n",
        "ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 2)\n",
        "ax2.pie(rating_counts.values,\n",
        "        labels=rating_counts.index,\n",
        "        autopct='%1.0f%%')\n",
        "ax2.set_title('Rating Share')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot 3\n",
        "ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 3)\n",
        "ax3.hist(df['Price'], bins=15,\n",
        "         color='orange', edgecolor='black')\n",
        "ax3.set_title('Price Distribution')\n",
        "ax3.set_xlabel('Price (£)')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot 4\n",
        "ax4 = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 4)\n",
        "avg_price.plot(kind='line', ax=ax4,\n",
        "               marker='o', color='green')\n",
        "ax4.set_title('Avg Price by Rating')\n",
        "ax4.set_xlabel('Rating')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot 5\n",
        "ax5 = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 5)\n",
        "ax5.scatter(df['Rating_Num'], df['Price'],\n",
        "            alpha=0.5, color='purple')\n",
        "ax5.set_title('Price vs Rating')\n",
        "ax5.set_xlabel('Rating')\n",
        "ax5.set_ylabel('Price')\n",
        "\n",
        "# Plot 6\n",
        "ax6 = fig.add_subplot(2, 3, 6)\n",
        "sns.heatmap(corr_data, annot=True,\n",
        "            cmap='coolwarm', ax=ax6)\n",
        "ax6.set_title('Correlation')\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.savefig('final_dashboard.png',\n",
        "            dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "print(\"Dashboard saved!\")"
      ],
